en.title: A ticket with your name on it
pages: Pip lands on the harbour rail and taps your ticket. “{city},” Pip reads. “That’s a long way for a little bird. Can I come too, {name}?”

en.title: Through gate {gate}
pages: The big plane waits by the window at gate {gate}. Pip counts the wheels twice, just to be sure. “All here,” Pip says. “Let’s find your seat, {name}.”

en.title: Extra time at gate {gate}
pages: The plane needs a little more time to get ready, so {name} and Pip get extra time at gate {gate}. They watch the luggage carts roll past. Pip counts eleven!

en.title: Above the clouds
pages: Down below, the clouds look like a soft white map. Pip draws a line across it with one wing, all the way to {city}.

en.title: Above the clouds
pages: We waited a little longer, so the clouds had time to puff up big and round. Pip says they look like sheep on a map.

en.title: Hello, {city}
pages: Lights everywhere, and a whole new city to see. Pip whispers, “We made it, {name}. Where shall we explore first?”

en.title: Hello, {city}
pages: We came in after dark, and {city} had switched on every light to say hello. Pip whispers, “Worth the wait, {name}. Where first?”
